profile.about: Creative professional with skills in Microsoft Office, CorelDRAW, Canva, and CapCut, as well as experience in Social Media Administration, Content Creation, and Videography. Possesses the ability to process data and documents, create visual designs, develop creative content, and manage social media effectively. Accustomed to working creatively, meticulously, adaptively, and capable of producing engaging content according to company and audience needs.
